title: Profile targets an assignment filter that matches nothing
when: it.Assignments.Any(a => a.Included && a.FilterMode == 'include' && a.FilterId != null && Facts.Filters.Any(f => f.Id == a.FilterId && f.MatchedCountKnown && f.MatchedDeviceCount == 0))

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile uses', 'profiles use')} a filter that matches no device

columns.Filter: it.Assignments.Where(a => a.Included && a.FilterMode == 'include' && a.FilterId != null && Facts.Filters.Any(f => f.Id == a.FilterId && f.MatchedCountKnown && f.MatchedDeviceCount == 0)).Select(a => a.FilterName)

messages.businessImpact: The included filter narrows this assignment to no device, so it appears deployed but reaches nobody through that assignment.
remediation: Check the filter rule against the device properties it references, since a renamed or empty property matches nothing.
messages.cannotSee: The evaluation counts tenant-wide filter matches, not whether devices in the assignment target group match. A zero tenant-wide count proves this assignment reaches no device; a positive count does not prove that it reaches one.
